meta.title: Reject Bid is disabled while bidding is on
gaps: Directly verify the backend refusal message "Bid rejection is disabled while bidding is in progress" for Reject Bid.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Directly verify the backend refusal message "Bid rejection is disabled while bidding is in progress" for Reject Bid.

steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ responses screen as required for this state.
Open the participant list so a second invited vendor can receive the surrogate bid.
Add the second bid at 90 to reproduce the RFQ with two bids.
Confirm the surrogate bid was submitted.
Return to the RFQ Responses tab where the Reject control is shown.
Confirm both bids are visible before checking the rejection control.
Assert the Reject Bid control is greyed out during bidding.
Verify the disabled control explains that rejection is unavailable during bidding.
